title: Hot Spinach and Artichoke Dip with Parmesan and Mozzarella
summary: Spinach is wilted with garlic and stirred with cream cheese, artichokes, mayonnaise, soured cream, lemon zest, mozzarella and Parmesan, then baked until bubbling and golden.

ingredients.item: frozen artichoke hearts, thawed, squeezed dry and chopped
baguette (about 300 g), sliced and toasted, to serve

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Heat the oil in the pan over medium-high heat. Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the spinach a handful at a time. Cook 3-4 minutes until the liquid has evaporated. Tip into the bowl.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the cream cheese into the warm spinach until melted, then mix in the artichokes, mayonnaise, soured cream, lemon zest, mozzarella, 45 g Parmesan, pepper and cayenne.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in the baking dish, top with the remaining Parmesan and bake 22-25 minutes until bubbling, golden and 74 °C in the centre.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Meanwhile toast the baguette slices on a tray in the oven for 6-8 minutes until crisp.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Rest the dip 5-10 minutes and serve hot with the toasts.

tips: Squeeze the thawed artichokes well in a tea towel so the dip isn't watery.
No salt is needed; the cheeses season the dip.
Assemble up to 2 days ahead and bake from cold, adding 10 minutes.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour and eat within 3 days. Reheat once until piping hot (74 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
